name: Kinematics
description: Speed, acceleration and suvat problems with fresh numbers every time, plus key definitions.

cards.prompt: A car travels {d} km in {t} h. What is its average speed in km/h?
A cyclist speeds up from {u} m/s to {v} m/s in {t} s. What is the acceleration in m/s²?
A car braking at constant rate goes from {u} m/s to a stop in {t} s. What is the size of its deceleration in m/s²?
A ball moving at {u} m/s accelerates at {a} m/s² for {t} s. What is its final speed in m/s?
A car starts from rest and accelerates at {a} m/s² for {t} s. How far does it travel, in m?
An object moving at {u} m/s accelerates at {a} m/s² over {s} m. What is its final speed in m/s?

cards.back: The change in position of an object: distance in a given direction (a vector), measured in m.

cards.front: Speed vs. velocity: what's the difference?
cards.back: Speed is how fast (a scalar). Velocity is how fast and in which direction (a vector).
The rate of change of velocity: $a = \frac{\Delta v}{t}$, measured in m/s².

cards.front: In the suvat equations, what do $s, u, v, a, t$ stand for?
cards.back: $s$ displacement, $u$ initial velocity, $v$ final velocity, $a$ acceleration, $t$ time.
